name: Cannabidiol
toxicity: well-tolerated and shows little to no toxicity
summary: Cannabidiol is a cannabinoid substance belonging to the Cannabinoid chemical class.

pharmacology.text: In vitro, cannabidiol has low affinity for, and acts as a negative allosteric modulator of the CB1 cannabinoid receptor. Cannabidiol may be an antagonist of GPR55, a G protein-coupled receptor and putative non-homologous CB3 cannabinoid receptor shown by in vitro studies to be widely distributed in the brain. Cannabidiol may interact with various neurotransmitters, such as serotonin, dopamine, and GABA.

uses.text: Medically, it is an anticonvulsant used to treat two rare forms of childhood epilepsy. Clinical research on CBD has included studies related to the treatment of anxiety, addiction, psychosis, movement disorders, and pain, but there is insufficient high-quality evidence that CBD is effective for these conditions.

sideEffects.text: Research indicates that cannabidiol may increase adverse effects of THC, particularly those causing intoxication and sedation, but only at high doses. Safety studies of cannabidiol showed it is well tolerated, but may cause fatigue, somnolence, sedation, diarrhea, or changes in appetite as common adverse effects, with the most common being somnolence and sedation. Side effects of CBD are dose related.

summaryZh: 大麻二酚（英語：Cannabidiol，簡稱：CBD）是從大麻中鑑定出的113種大麻素之一，與四氫大麻酚一起佔了植物提取物的40%。FDA核准用於治療兩種罕見的兒童癲癇症。大麻二酚於1940年被發現。相關的臨床研究包括治療焦慮、成癮、精神病、運動障礙和疼痛等研究，目前沒有足夠的實證醫學證據表明臨床效果。

fact.en: Cannabidiol was first isolated from cannabis in 1940, but its exact structure was only worked out in 1963 by Raphael Mechoulam and Yuval Shvo in Israel.
fact.zh: 大麻二酚在 1940 年首次從大麻中分離出來，但它確切的結構直到 1963 年才由以色列的拉斐爾·梅舒朗與尤瓦爾·須沃解開。
fact.zhHans: 大麻二酚在 1940 年首次从大麻中分离出来，但它确切的结构直到 1963 年才由以色列的拉斐尔·梅舒朗与尤瓦尔·须沃解开。
